text:
invoice-bot: New invoice received from Tempest Labs: INV-2026-0912 for $7,450. PDF: https://invoices.redwood/INV-2026-0912. Vendor referenced PO: PO-8891. Auto-extracted GL: 4201. Please review.

lina_fin: I pulled the PDF — vendor split charges across two cost centers (ENG and ML Research). PO-8891 only covers the ENG consulting line. There's a ML training line for $2,500 that has no PO match.

raj: @lina_fin can you confirm whether Procurement created a split PO? If not, we'll need to route approvals to two different cost-center approvers.

amy_ops: Procurement didn't create a second PO. Tempest told us they only referenced PO-8891 on their side. Vendor says they cannot reissue without an updated PO from us. cc @kevin_s

kevin_s: If AP posts as-is the ML amount will be miscoded. Options: 1) request vendor reissue with separate POs (preferred for audit), or 2) create manual split in AP coding and route to both approvers (faster). Which do we want?

lina_fin: We need to clear this quickly — invoice due in 7 days. Manual split is fastest for payment, but we should attempt reissue first. @sara can you confirm ML approver?

sara: ML approver is dr_mitra (I can ping but FYI they're OOO Wed-Thu).

raj: Can James (engineering lead) provide temporary approval delegation if dr_mitra is OOO? He has delegation rights, right?

james_eng: I can approve the ML line if Procurement is OK with manual coding and we attach a clear audit note: "manual split per vendor limitation; awaiting reissued PO."

procurement-bot: NOTE — creating split coding will create two AP lines that reference a single vendor invoice. The second line will not match PO lookup automatically and will require an approval override in Coupa. Please attach vendor confirmation.

lina_fin: I'll open the AP ticket and email the vendor requesting a reissue with two POs. If no reply in 24h we'll proceed with manual split and James' approval.

amy_ops: Please include CSR# 48211 when you email Tempest so they can find the original order.

lina_fin: Sent to vendor: `Hi Tempest team — can you re-issue INV-2026-0912 with separate POs: PO-8891 (ENG) and PO-8892 (ML Research for $2,500). If you cannot re-issue, please confirm in writing that we may split and code manually.`

invoice-bot: Invoice INV-2026-0912 status updated: vendor replied — "We can reissue but need PO-8892 from your side; we cannot edit the invoice on our system."

raj: Procurement — can you create PO-8892 today for $2,500 (ML training services)? Vendor is waiting.

procurement-bot: PO creation request received: ticket PR-562. Expected to create PO-8892 after approvals (ETA ~6 hours). Will post update when PO is live.

lina_fin: I'll hold off manual split until PO-8892 exists. If PO not created by EOD we'll perform manual split and attach James' approval and vendor email to the AP ticket.

james_eng: :thumbsup: that works for me.

lina_fin: Thanks all — I'll update the AP ticket (AP-3247) and mark as urgent. Will follow up when PO-8892 is created or if vendor declines.
